name: optimiziramsi
description: optimiziramsi's Claude Code toolkit — one plugin per concern (git, commit, reporting, session, review, flow, instructions, patterns, worktree, repo, setup); each project enables the ones it wants.

plugins.name: commit
plugins.description: House commit style — bare single-line messages, topic-close + pause-for-review cadence, safe staging; a commit-format guard and an end-of-session commit nudge.

plugins.name: flow
plugins.description: Work management — plan, milestone, scope-cut, triage-todo, feedback, plus the looper / grind / collab background runners; ships the .todo readonly guard (arm with "ALLOW TODO").

plugins.name: git
plugins.description: Git safety net — a git-guard hook that blocks push/pull, bulk adds, non-FF merges, protected-branch moves, hard resets, --no-verify and discards; plus the hotfix skill.

plugins.name: instructions
plugins.description: Keep the agent-instruction system alive — retro, lessons, instructions-audit, instructions-maintenance, rules-change; lesson-scout + instructions-auditor agents; caps, file-guard, meta-lint and tripwire-guard hooks.

plugins.name: patterns
plugins.description: Per-topic pattern registry under .agent/patterns/ — manage-patterns, pattern-compliance / pattern-verifier agents, and hooks that gate edits governed only by non-blessed patterns.

plugins.name: repo
plugins.description: rename — move a file and cascade every reference across docs, skills and config.

plugins.name: reporting
plugins.description: Lean-reporting output contract, enforced — injected per prompt, re-pulsed every Nth tool call, and a Stop guard that blocks a narrating or over-long final message.

plugins.name: review
plugins.description: Structured review — review (P0/HIGH/MED/LOW → .agent/reviews/) and qa-gate skills, plus semantic, spec, wireframe, doc-drift and isolation reviewer agents.

plugins.name: session
plugins.description: Session continuity — handoff (next-session notes, ≤4k), continue, session-summary, and a SessionStart state snapshot.

plugins.name: setup
plugins.description: One-time bootstrap — scaffold the .agent/ workspace and write a house-style slim-router CLAUDE.md.

plugins.name: worktree
plugins.description: Parallel isolated work — the worktree protocol (reserve → plan → review-gated slices → land) plus guards that keep edits inside the active worktree.

plugins.name: optimiziramsi-skills
plugins.description: Deprecated bundle — installs and enables every optimiziramsi plugin at once. Enable the individual plugins your project wants instead: while this bundle is enabled none of them can be disabled.
